title: Constructibility criterion on irreducible closed subsets of a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] admitting a finite affine open cover by spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum] of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $E\subseteq |Y|$ be a subset. Suppose that for every irreducible closed subset $Z\subseteq |Y|$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], there is a nonempty relatively open subset $V\subseteq Z$ such that either $V\subseteq E$ or $V\cap E=\varnothing$. Then $E$ is constructible in $|Y|$ [def-weil-constructible-subset].

source.place: Tag 053Z (lemma-characterize-constructible-Noetherian), implication (2) to (1): a nonempty open disjoint from E is equivalent to E intersect Z not being dense in Z. The scheme specialization uses Properties Tag 01OZ (lemma-Noetherian-topology) in literature/stacks-project/properties.tex.
